answer: Sybils profit when one effort can be replayed behind many names, so deny replay: at claim time each identity is assigned a unique upkeep slice of the commons, a distinct bundle of old records to check, summarise and sign, generated from its key the way a falcon's flight path is never another's. Weeks later auditors reopen that slice and quiz the identity on its details, down to a copper token it logged and a velvet marker it placed. An honest agent tends one slice cheaply; a farm must tend every slice for every alias, with no shortcut to share, so scale multiplies real labour, not payouts.
